entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: S3 drop bucket where order flat files arrive from the ERP system.

entities.name: SQS
entities.rationale: Queue triggered by incoming S3 files to handle messaging.

entities.name: Initiator Lambda
entities.rationale: Launched by SQS to retrieve metadata from DynamoDB and push structured data to the data lake.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Stores metadata and pipeline configuration queried by the initiator Lambda.

entities.name: Data Lake
entities.rationale: S3/Lake Formation data lake containing raw and refined buckets.

entities.name: Processing Lambda
entities.rationale: Triggered by data lake S3 events to merge order and inventory datasets and run stats models.

entities.name: Redshift
entities.rationale: Data warehouse cluster storing invoice, demand, and analytics data for business reporting.

entities.name: On Prem
entities.rationale: On-premises database storing enterprise sales and invoice data.

entities.name: VPN
entities.rationale: Secure network connection bridging the on-premises environment into AWS.

entities.name: DMS
entities.rationale: AWS Database Migration Service using CDC to replicate on-premises sales data into Redshift.

visual_connections.description: Drop bucket generates events into the SQS queue.
SQS message triggers the initiator Lambda job.
Initiator Lambda queries DynamoDB for file metadata.
Initiator Lambda writes structured data into the Data Lake.
Event trigger in Data Lake launches the processing/merging Lambda.
Processing Lambda loads transformed demand files into Redshift.
Data from Redshift is integrated back into the Data Lake.
On-premises sales database traffic routes across the VPN.
DMS captures CDC data streaming across the VPN connection.
DMS loads replicated invoice-level data into Redshift.
